Subject: Next steps — technical immersion (60–90m): windows, attendees & agenda

Hi Priya / Michael,

Thanks again for the discovery earlier — great to hear more about KetlCorp's plan to standardize LLM-based search and insights across analytics and customer support. As discussed, the most useful next step is a 60–90 minute technical immersion with our ML/infra leads so we can:

- Walk through a short architecture map of how Redwood would fit into your platform
- Validate latency / throughput assumptions with your expected query mix
- Review data controls (VPC routing, key management, and retention) and any compliance constraints
- Surface model/quantization tradeoffs and recommended runtime configuration

Proposed slots (PT):
1) Wed 2027-06-30 10:00–11:30 AM PT
2) Thu 2027-07-01 1:00–2:30 PM PT

Please reply with your preferred window and a short attendee list (names + roles). If neither works, tell us a few alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Attached is a short draft agenda and a mutual action plan we can iterate on. Marissa (cc) will lead the technical session; Ben will join for contractual/next-step items.

Quick asks to help us prepare:
- A representative production query profile (qps and typical token counts) or a short sample CSV of queries
- Any firm constraints on data residency or key rotation cadence

Looking forward to locking this in — we'll send a calendar invite once we have a slot.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Priya / Michael — happy to join as the lead for the technical session. Confirming Thu 2027-07-01 1:00–2:30 PM PT on our side. I'll be the primary infra engineer and will cover:

- 20m architecture deep-dive: routing, autoscaling, and hot/cold cache design
- 20m performance evaluation: sample QPS, token distributions, and expected latencies across our hosting options (hosted vs dedicated)
- 15m security/compliance: KMS/HSM integration, audit logs, and retention controls
- 15m ops & runbook: rollout strategies, canaries, and rollback behaviors
- 10m open Q&A + next steps (MAP and action owners)

Requests to help us make the session immediately actionable:
- Please share the anonymized query set you mentioned and any SLO targets (p95 latency goals, target throughput).
- If you have a network diagram (VPC/subnet/peering) that would be useful for the KMS/key routing discussion.

I'll prepare a 6-slide runbook summary and a small perf-projection table to walk through during the call. Ben — can you confirm you'll join the last 10–15 minutes to discuss contracting/timeline?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
